posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Andy: We'll be working on additional platforms right away, so you shouldn't have to wait too long. Android emulators don't tend to support Google Play or Amazon Appstore properly (or for very long, once they get noticed and C&D'd by the companies).

Powerhound: Not sure exactly, but it'll be on the order of a few hundred megabytes. Pretty art takes lots of bits.

posts.name: chainsawrabbit
posts.cooked:
Time to find whatever hole my Kindle fell into and start excavatin'.  I must have this game so I can get some Sentinels action in whenever I feel like it, instead of herding cats (gamers).  Plus, Super-Scientific Tachyon bonus awesomeness!  I had a friend that attended PAX Prime, but I didn't know he was going until right after he left, and he didn't check his phone the entire weekend he was there.

@MigrantP: Are there any limitations on what "generation" of Kindle will run the game?  Mine's pretty old, but I downloaded and played Fantasy Flight Games' Elder Signs: Omens game about a year and a half ago, and it worked just fine.  Maybe I should see if there are any OS updates, just in case.
